create_CPUOffloadingSpec: create a CPUOffloadingSpec instance with VllmConfig and KVCacheConfig to configure CPU KV cache offloading
get_CPUOffloadingManager: get the CPUOffloadingManager from CPUOffloadingSpec for managing KV cache block eviction and storage
get_offloading_handlers: get GPU-to-CPU and CPU-to-GPU offloading handler pairs from CPUOffloadingSpec for KV cache transfer
configure_eviction_policy: configure the eviction policy for CPU KV cache offloading using LRU or other cache replacement strategies
filter_reused_blocks: wrap the CPUOffloadingManager with FilterReusedOffloadingManager to skip offloading blocks below a store threshold
